subject: Partnership Proposal
body_plain:
Hi,

I hope this email finds you well. I'm reaching out from Startup.io to discuss a potential partnership opportunity between our companies.

We've been following your work in the AI security space and believe there's significant synergy between our products. I'd love to schedule a brief call to explore how we might work together.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call next week?

Best,
Mike
